row.evidence: Cloud Observability's SSO docs say 'The Okta integration uses System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM)' to provision, de-provision and update users; Entra ID and OneLogin are SAML only (OneLogin with JIT), and no generic SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: Lightstep was renamed ServiceNow Cloud Observability in August 2023 and is end-of-life: supported through March 1, 2026 or the subscription term end, whichever is later, so it can no longer be newly bought. SCIM works only through Okta's Lightstep OIN app, which points at the public API base https://api.lightstep.com/public/v0.2/{org} with an API key; there is no documented generic SCIM endpoint, hence partial. The pricing page (lightstep.com/pricing redirects to servicenow.com) blocked every fetch, so the plan gate is not verified: Enterprise is taken from the JIT doc, which assumes 'a Cloud Observability Enterprise account and an IdP' (docs, not pricing; low confidence). The public API can list, create (invite) and delete users.

auth.token_source: Cloud Observability API key with Organization Admin privileges, entered as Okta's API Token

deprovision.notes: Okta 'Deactivate Users' is documented, but what it does in Cloud Observability is not.

roles.how: New users get the organization's default role; roles can also be mapped from SAML attributes.

limitations.text: SCIM provisioning is documented only for Okta; Entra ID is a custom SAML app and OneLogin is SAML with JIT.
Product end-of-life: supported through March 1, 2026 or subscription term end.

scim.notes: Documented only as Okta's Lightstep app; plan inferred from the JIT doc's Enterprise prerequisite because the pricing page could not be loaded.

endpoints.purpose: Create New User (invites by email, default role)

user_api.notes: Role assignment is documented via Terraform (user_role_binding) rather than an API write endpoint.

okta.notes: OIN page markup ticks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate.

entra.notes: Docs use a non-gallery 'Create your own application' SAML app.

google.notes: Google sign-in is OAuth2 'Sign in with Google', not SAML; no Google catalogue app checked.

onelogin.notes: Vendor docs: SAML with JIT provisioning only.

fallbacks.other_sync: Terraform provider for user role bindings; bulk create/delete via public API
